```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame (or use your existing df)
df = nw.from_native(pd.DataFrame({
    "store": ["A", "B", "A", "B", "A"],
    "revenue": [100, 200, 150, 300, 120],
    "items": [5, 10, 7, 15, 6]
}))

# Group by store and aggregate
result = df.group_by("store").agg(
    revenue_sum=nw.col("revenue").sum(),
    items_mean=nw.col("items").mean()
)

print(result)
```
